name: AI risk score routes vendor contracts
description: A Third-Party Paper Review request starts the routing. An AI agent scores the attached vendor contract 1-10: 1-3 is auto-approved, 4-7 goes to legal ops, 8-10 to the general counsel.
prerequisites: Requesters attach the contract on the request's Documents tab after submitting: an intake-form upload is not a request document, and the agent cannot read it.
